heroSummary: Students in grades 1–12 start school on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Preschool and kindergarten students start Tuesday, September 8, after Family Connections on September 2–4. The scheduled last day is Monday, June 21, 2027, with a one-hour early dismissal. January 28 may be used as the first emergency makeup day; June 22 and 23 are additional makeup days if needed.
calendarNotes: SPS lists 180 student days and five TRI days. January 28, 2027 is the day between semesters; it is also listed as Emergency Closure Make Up Day 1 if SPS needs to make up a closure. June 22 and June 23 are additional emergency makeup days.

We use the district webpage for those family-facing details and the PDF for TRI days, term dates, day counts, and emergency makeup dates.
We verified holidays, Winter Break, Mid-Winter Break, Spring Break, semester dates, conference dates, final student day, and emergency closure makeup days against the official SPS sources.
The PDF lists January 28 as both the day between semesters and Emergency Closure Make Up Day 1. This page explains that dual role instead of treating the date as a normal attendance day.
The SPS calendar notes that early release occurs every Wednesday except the first week of school. Families should confirm weekly dismissal times with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When do preschool and kindergarten students start school?
calendarFaqs.a: Preschool and kindergarten students start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Family Connections are scheduled for September 2–4.

calendarFaqs.q: Are schools closed during the November conference days?
calendarFaqs.a: Most elementary and K–8 schools are closed for family-teacher conferences on November 23–25, but schedules vary by school. Most middle schools remain open, so families should check their school calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Is January 28 a regular no-school day or a makeup day?
calendarFaqs.a: January 28 is the scheduled day between semesters, but SPS may use it as the first makeup day after an emergency closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later SPS revisions.
